finish.summary: Built L-shaped cluster of 3 full bases sharing one junction, with mount spike and large platform accessory at that junction. Capped and bolted.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your corner display stand with a raised spike platform — I'll build it.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

events.text: You've got the three bases at the corner - now I'll raise the platform on its spike.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

outcomes.message: a solid spike cannot carry a platform; only a mount spike can: details.steps fits a mount spike on the same junction, then the platform.
a solid spike cannot carry a platform; only a mount spike can: details.steps fits a mount spike on the same junction, then the platform.

events.text: The platform is up — I'll do the final checks to complete your display.
